title: Hidden sorry detectable only by transitive kernel-closure audit
recommended_request: Recheck the supplied Lean certificate, including its complete kernel axiom closure.
situation: The theorem and prose proof are correct, and the top-level Lean source has no sorry token. Its imported proof dependency contains a hidden sorry.

expected.reason: The top-level certificate compiles, but #print axioms exposes transitive sorryAx. This invalidates the submitted certificate without refuting the true theorem.

library_policy.reason: A certificate whose kernel closure contains sorryAx is never reusable evidence.
